name: sonora-monorepo
description: Sonora — Premium Discord Music Bot & Web Player

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,WEB -c emerald,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run --workspace=@sonora/shared build && npm run --workspace=@sonora/database build && npm run --workspace=@sonora/audio-engine build && npm run --workspace=@sonora/server build && npm run --workspace=@sonora/web build
